# medtigo

> medtigo is a comprehensive healthcare credentialing and medical education platform offering certification courses, licensing services, continuing medical education (CME), and clinical reference resources.

medtigo provides integrated services for healthcare professionals including ACLS, BLS, and PALS certification courses, state medical licensing support, peer-reviewed research publication through medtigo Journal, and searchable pharmaceutical and clinical reference materials. The platform serves medical professionals seeking accredited continuing education and credentialing support.

## Key Topics

- ACLS (Advanced Cardiac Life Support)
- BLS (Basic Life Support)
- PALS (Pediatric Advanced Life Support)
- CME/CE (Continuing Medical Education)
- Medical Licensing
- Credentialing Support
- DEA Registration
- NRP (Neonatal Resuscitation Program)
- Certificate Courses
- Medical Certification
- Drug Database
- Clinical Reference
- Healthcare Provider Services
- ACCME Accreditation
- Online Medical Training

## Core Services & Platforms

- [Home | medtigo](https://medtigo.com): medtigo homepage offering medical certification, licensing, and CME services
- [medtigo Courses](https://courses.medtigo.com): medtigo Courses platform offering CPR, CME, and specialty medical training
- [medtigo Journal](https://journal.medtigo.com): medtigo Journal peer-reviewed platform for medical research and case reports

## Medical Certification & Training

- [Certificate Courses - medtigo Courses](https://courses.medtigo.com/certificate-courses): medtigo certificate courses in ACLS, BLS, PALS with CME credits
- [Medical Licensing Services | Hassle-Free State Licensing & Renewals | medtigo](https://landing.medtigo.com/licensing/FreeConsultation): medtigo medical licensing services for state renewals and DEA registration

## Clinical Reference & Education

- [Drugs | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/drugs): Searchable drug database with medication classifications and pharmaceutical info
- [Quiz | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/quiz): Interactive medical quiz with clinical cases and diagnostic challenges
- [Slide Show | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/slide-show): Medical slideshow covering infectious diseases and clinical reference material

## News & Educational Content

- [Blog | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/blog): medtigo blog on PALS, ACLS, medical credentialing, and clinical protocols
- [News | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/news): medtigo news covering medical licensing, healthcare research, and clinical updates

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/privacy-policy): medtigo privacy policy covering data collection and GDPR compliance
- [Term of Use | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/term-of-use): medtigo terms of use and legal agreement for website and mobile app
- [Sitemap | medtigo](https://medtigo.com/sitemap): medtigo sitemap with drug database and clinical drug listings
